About me

Most food apps and viral videos are made far away from places like mine. I want to make things where Bihar is not the background — it's the main character.

Coding, with roots

I'm a 1st-year BTech student and coding is my main focus — I'm building towards becoming a software developer. This portfolio itself is part of that: I asked for it in code, not only in Figma.

I started with an idea no big app was serving well: proper Bihari food, ordered the way people at home actually eat. That became Swad Bihar — my own UI, my own flow, with AI features like a Food Buddy that suggests dishes by mood, diet and budget.

On video, the same instinct runs everything — a Chhath Puja film where Thekua is the hero, cartoon vegetables arguing in the kitchen, a monsoon lyrics video for Barsaat. Culture first, format second.

Featured project

A Zomato-style food app — but with its own UI, its own identity, and Bihari dishes at the centre instead of an afterthought.

Swad Bihar

A food delivery app concept focused on Indian food with a special love for Bihari dishes. Home screen leads with Litti Chokha, Sattu, Thekua and Chhath Specials, and an AI Pick banner up top. The restaurant example — Litti Chokha House — keeps prices honest and local:

03

Hackathon projects

Hackathons are where coding stops being practice and becomes building under a deadline. This is my hackathon project — a small idea aimed at a very real, everyday problem.

TruckTrail

Hackathon Project

Find the nearest food truck, fast — built for a lunch break that lasts only 30 minutes.

The problem

When your lunch break is just 30 minutes, there is no time to wander around looking for food. By the time you find a place and get served, the break is nearly over — and the food still has to be eaten.

What TruckTrail does

TruckTrail gives you information about the nearest food truck during your lunch break, so you can head straight to the closest option and get your food on time — with minutes left to actually enjoy it.

30 minutes — the full lunch break TruckTrail is designed around

06

How I work

  1. 1

    Start from home

    Every project begins with something real from Bihar — a dish, a festival, a song, a joke from the kitchen.

  2. 2

    Design the full flow

    Not one pretty screen — the whole journey. For Swad Bihar that's login to live tracking, connected as a working prototype.

  3. 3

    Add one smart twist

    An AI Food Buddy in the app, Thekua as the hero in the Chhath film — one idea that makes the work mine.

  4. 4

    Ship, then make the next one better

    Series thinking: the next vegetable clip must be funnier, the next song scene must fit tighter.
